about: Venus's item inventory: the canonical registry. lib/items.mjs and the item grammar read only this file; inventory.md is generated from it (node items-build.mjs) and a test fails if the two drift. Gag ids are the bible's running gags (§5-§6, or data/character.json once it exists); formulas are §3's A-E.

interactions.sits-in: She sits inside it; its front wall is drawn over her lower body (occlusion), the seat has its own contact shadow, and it pops up under her on the bag beat (the score's `bag` track).
interactions.sits-on: She sits on top of it: lifted by the seat's height, paws sinking into its front edge.
interactions.wears-head: Worn on the head, in the rig's head space: it follows head roll, pitch and yaw.
interactions.wears-face: Worn on the face (eye line or forehead), squashed per side with the head's yaw like her eyes.
interactions.wears-neck: Worn at the neck, between body and head so her chin overlaps it.
interactions.beside: Stands on the floor beside her with a contact shadow; on milestones it pops in at the number.
interactions.guards: Beside her; on the last sentence her eyes slide to it (the treat guard of photo 10).
interactions.watches: Beside her; her eyes go to it during the reaction beat.
interactions.rolls-in: Rolls in from off-frame during the entrance, rotation matching distance, and stops at her side; she watches it.
interactions.dangles-bats: Dangles from off-frame top on a string, swinging; her eyes track it and she pats at it twice with her raised paw after the number.
interactions.chases-dot: A red dot wanders over the wall behind her from the reaction on; her eyes follow it.
interactions.flutters: Flies in on the punchline sentence in a figure-eight by her head; her eyes follow it.
interactions.pops: Fires at the number: a kick, a pop, streamers and paper bits from its mouth.
interactions.floats: Tied to a little weight on the floor, bobbing high in frame, visible over the caption.
interactions.ignores: Beside her and pointedly not looked at: during the reaction her eyes go up and away from it, chin high; on the last sentence one sneaky glance back at it.
interactions.rig-outfit: Already in the rig (`outfit`), changed under the outfit poof.

rules.propSides: Floor props stand at x ±228 rig units (or their own propX). Props that carry glyphs always stand screen-left, out of the Reels right rail. A sprawl puts her body screen-left, so props go right; the feather wand hangs screen-left, where her raised paw reaches.
rules.bagLines: A quip that names a bag always gets a bag (paper-bag or kraft-bag) when the plan has a seat; two bag days in a row alternate the two bags.

items.name: Cardboard box
items.why: If it fits, she sits: the most universal cat truth there is, and a throne made of trash suits a diva whose act keeps collapsing.
items.beat: Bag-hop entrance or bag-throne move on a line that does not name a bag: the box pops up as she lands, flaps splayed like a royal canopy.
items.localeNotes: Text-free; the arrows are an icon, not words.

items.name: Paper bag (yellow)
items.why: The bag throne of photos 15 and 16, redrawn as a crisp brand-yellow shopping bag: a handle flopped forward over the front, the other rising behind her like a canopy.
items.beat: Every line that names a bag. The punchline is the bag; she is the queen of it.
items.localeNotes: Print is a speech bubble with three dots; no letters, no shop marks.

items.name: Paper bag (kraft)
items.why: The same throne in brown paper, so two bag days in a row never show the same bag ('I found a new bag today').
items.beat: Bag lines on the day after a yellow bag; also the bag on the yellow 'stripes' ground.

items.name: Laundry basket
items.why: Clean laundry is a cat magnet; the striped sock over the rim says she has been in it all day.
items.beat: Bag-hop entrance on a non-bag line; reads as 'found a better throne'.

items.name: Throne cushion
items.why: The one real throne she owns: velvet, gold piping, tassels. Day 14 she naps on it, which undoes the whole regal effect.
items.beat: Day 14 (naps): already under her when she wakes. Otherwise a seat on bag-hop days.

items.name: Open suitcase
items.why: Every cat claims the suitcase. For a language app it is the trip you are learning for, and she has packed herself.
items.beat: Bag-hop entrance on a non-bag line. The lid stands behind her like a throne back, travel stickers on its lining.
items.localeNotes: One sticker shows 'Aa'; Latin letters read as 'alphabet' in every locale.

items.name: Warm keyboard
items.why: She sits on the keyboard exactly when you want to study. A poke at the habit that hurts nobody.
items.beat: Habit tease: 'You study. I sit on it.'
items.localeNotes: Keys blank: a keyboard layout is locale-specific.

items.name: A box far too small
items.needsRigMove: squeeze: haunches overflowing a seat narrower than her
items.why: If it almost fits, she still sits. Pure formula A.
items.beat: She sits in a tissue-box-sized box; only half of her is in it; 'Perfect fit.'

items.name: Fruit bowl
items.why: A cat curled in the fruit bowl is a classic 'this is so my cat'.
items.beat: Counter days: she is the fruit now.

items.name: Pizza box
items.why: Warm, flat, smells of cheese: a throne by cat logic.
items.beat: Regular days, 'could involve snacks' pokes.

items.name: Donut cat bed (ignored)
items.why: The expensive bed she never uses, sitting empty beside her while she sits in its box.
items.beat: Paired with the cardboard box.

items.name: Open drawer
items.needsRigMove: a set piece: furniture edge at frame bottom
items.why: Any open drawer is hers within seconds.
items.beat: Peek entrance out of a drawer.

items.name: Feather wand
items.needsRigMove: a sideways left-paw swat (today she pats with the right paw lift)
items.why: Hunter mode (photo 17). Her dignity lasts exactly until the feathers move.
items.beat: Formula C: the speech starts, the feathers swing, her eyes go with them, she pats twice, then pretends nothing happened.

items.name: The red dot
items.needsRigMove: hunt-wiggle (bible §9.2 #2) for the full stalk and pounce
items.why: Her one love she never catches (§5, once a month). It works with the sound off: everyone knows the dot.
items.beat: The dot crosses the wall behind her during the reaction; her eyes snap to it mid-verdict.

items.name: Ball of yarn
items.why: The picture-book cat toy, with the needles still in it: somebody's knitting is ruined and she is proud.
items.beat: Rolls in on the entrance and stops at her side; she watches it go by instead of the number.

items.name: Wind-up toy mouse
items.why: Her 'prey', key still turning. She keeps an eye on it like it might report her.
items.beat: Sits beside her; her eyes flick to it during the reaction, then back to you.

items.name: Catnip fish
items.why: The plush she would never admit she sleeps with.
items.beat: Soft and cosy days, beside her loaf.

items.name: The moth
items.why: A visitor, not a toy: the thing that wipes out her verdict in ro-12.
items.beat: Flies in exactly on '…Ooh, a moth.' and loops round her head; her eyes follow it.

items.name: Crinkle ball
items.why: Noisy and shiny; a sound gag (crinkle SFX exists).
items.beat: Rolls in on a crinkle.

items.name: Plastic spring
items.why: The cheapest toy, the most loved.
items.beat: Bounces in on a boing.

items.name: Bottle cap
items.why: A thing to knock off a ledge in your honour.
items.beat: Knock-off: she taps it off, looks at you.

items.name: Stolen hair tie
items.why: Every cat owner's missing hair ties are under this cat.
items.beat: She sits on a pile of them.

items.name: Treat pouch
items.why: Photo 10: she stands guard over two treat packets. Every 'could involve snacks' poke comes back to this.
items.beat: ro-06: on '…Could involve snacks' her eyes slide to the pouch. Other days it is simply hers.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a fish emblem and a window of treats.

items.name: Food bowl
items.why: A full bowl and a cat acting like it is empty: relatable to every owner.
items.beat: Cosy days; the slow blink over a full bowl.
items.localeNotes: Text-free; a paw print, not a name.

items.name: A whole fish
items.why: Where did she get it? Nobody asks. She glances at it like a co-conspirator.
items.beat: Watched during the reaction beat.

items.name: Hamsi
items.why: Canon: her favourite fish is the hamsi, the European anchovy. A goddess whose dream dinner is the smallest, cheapest fish at the market is the whole character on one plate: grand taste, humble cat.
items.beat: On the last sentence her eyes slide to the plate (the treat guard). Planned: she 'only sniffs' one and it is gone (formula A), or says 'acceptable' while her tail quivers at it (B).
items.localeNotes: Text-free: three small fish on a blue-rimmed saucer. Always a whole fresh fish, never the salted fillet: in en, es, fr and pt-BR 'anchovy' can mean the pizza topping, so lines say 'my fish' or 'hamsi' and never 'salty'.

items.name: Plain boiled chicken
items.why: The pinnacle. Every cat owner knows it: the fancy food gets a sniff, plain boiled chicken gets a full-body reaction. Her diva palate's highest award goes to the plainest thing in the kitchen.
items.beat: Reserved for big days: steam curls, on the last sentence her eyes go to it and her ears give her away (the tell). Proposed as the day-100 reward (open question).
items.localeNotes: Text-free: shredded pale strips in the brand-blue bowl, two curls of steam. No seasoning, no bones, ever: the vet-safe version is the funny one.

items.name: Wet food pouch
items.why: The ritual: the tear, the squeeze, the plop. She licks the gravy off every chunk, leaves the chunks, and announces she is starving.
items.beat: Her eyes go to the saucer on the last sentence. Planned gag: she licked the sauce, the rest is yours.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a teal pouch, a paw print, a torn zigzag top; gravy and chunks on a saucer.

items.name: Tuna can
items.why: The sound of the can opener summons her from anywhere in the building: a verdict or a nap is abandoned mid-word. Tuna water (the drained liquid) is her idea of a cocktail.
items.beat: Watched during the reaction beat, ears up (formula B). Wants an off-screen ring-pull SFX at the reveal (not built: needs a new sfx kind in lib/audio.mjs).
items.localeNotes: No label text: a silver tin with a plain blue band and a fish silhouette; the ring-pull lid peeled up.

items.name: Lickable treat tube
items.why: The one food that ends any cat's dignity: she follows the tube across the room, licking, eyes shut, and then claims she wasn't that interested.
items.beat: On the last sentence her eyes slide to the squeezed tube. Planned: the tell at full volume (ears and tail) while she says 'meh'.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a squeezed pink tube with a curl of paste and a fresh mint one; stripes, no words.

items.name: The “empty” bowl
items.why: A cat truth every owner knows: the bowl is still three-quarters full, but the bottom shows in the middle, so it is EMPTY. A national emergency.
items.beat: Watched during the reaction beat: she stares at the bare patch (its paw print showing) as if it were the number. Two kibbles she scooped out lie on the floor.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: kibble round the rim, the bowl's own paw print visible in the middle.

items.name: Pot of catnip
items.why: Catnip turns a goddess into a rolling, drooling mess for ten minutes, then she looks around as if nothing happened. The best formula C prop there is.
items.beat: Watched during the reaction beat. Planned: one sniff wipes her verdict ('Mrrr… where was I?'); one leaf is already bitten.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a terracotta pot, toothed leaves, lilac flower spikes. In lines: catnip, kedi otu, hierba gatera, herbe à chat, Katzenminze, кошачья мята, erva-dos-gatos, نعناع القطط.

items.name: Cat grass
items.why: She eats it with great ceremony, like a salad at a spa. What happens twenty minutes later stays off screen; the hairball is at most a sound and a cough, never a picture.
items.beat: Watched during the reaction beat; two chewed blades flop over the rim.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a white tray of bright straight blades.

items.name: The water fountain
items.why: Someone bought her an expensive filtered fountain. She drinks from your glass, the tap, the shower and the plant saucer instead. The fountain is decor.
items.beat: New interaction `ignores`: during the reaction her eyes go up and away from it, chin high; on the last sentence one sneaky glance back.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a white basin, a spout, a running arc of water.

items.name: Your glass of water
items.why: The only water worth drinking is in a human's glass. She dips a paw in first and licks the paw, as a quality check.
items.beat: Watched during the reaction beat; a drip down the side and a puddle say the paw went in. Never knocked off: the bible keeps glasses out of the knock-off gag.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a tall glass, half full, a ripple and a drip.

items.name: The butter dish
items.why: The lid is off and the butter has a perfect tongue-shaped groove along one edge. Nobody saw anything. She was on the counter, where she is not allowed, which is why she is always there.
items.beat: On the last sentence her eyes slide to it, then the innocent stare. Pairs with the Counter running gag.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a yellow block on a mint dish, the lid knocked aside, a licked scoop with tongue marks.

items.name: Your plate
items.why: The stolen bite: she ignores her own bowl to take one bite from yours, then acts as if the sandwich came that way.
items.beat: On the last sentence her eyes slide to the plate; crumbs on the rim. A 'habit' poke at most: it is your snack, never your effort.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a blue-rimmed plate, half a sandwich with a scalloped bite out of the corner.

items.name: Yogurt pot and its lid
items.why: The lid is hers by law. The human peels it, she licks it to a mirror shine and considers it a shared meal. Tiny, real, and very Turkish-kitchen.
items.beat: On the last sentence her eyes slide to the shiny lid on the floor.
items.localeNotes: Text-free: a plain white pot with a blue band, a silver foil lid with a glint.

items.name: Sunglasses
items.why: Peak diva act on a tiny cat with enormous ears; funnier the more serious she looks.
items.beat: Day 7 paparazzi flashes; 'I say that to the sun too' (ro-07).

items.name: Crown
items.why: Named after a goddess; the crown is crooked, which is the whole joke.
items.beat: Day 50 (the counter pose) and day 365 (a queen bows, briefly).
items.localeNotes: Gems are colours, no regalia of any real country.

items.name: Knitted scarf
items.why: Cosy and a little too big for her; huggable.
items.beat: Soft and praise days; never with the hoodie or onesie.

items.name: Party hat
items.why: Worn crooked off one ear by a cat who claims she does not celebrate.
items.beat: Day 30 with the confetti cannon.

items.name: Polka-dot bow
items.why: She dressed up a little to meet you, and pretends she did not.
items.beat: Day 1 (a little shy); 'This is my good side' (reg-04).

items.name: Headphones
items.why: Headphones on a cat whose ears stick straight up through them: a listening-practice joke on her own ears.
items.beat: Ear-swivel days: the ears move, the headphones do not.

items.name: Reading glasses
items.why: The judge's look, on a cat who sat on her notes.
items.beat: Day 21 (the verdict), 'Today's verdict' (reg-14).

items.name: Beret
items.why: An artiste. Her ears push it off-centre.
items.beat: Model-turn days.
items.localeNotes: A beret is international; no flag.

items.name: Gold star sticker
items.why: She gives you a gold star and wears it herself.
items.beat: pr-08 'Gold star. Well, gold-green. Like my eyes.'

items.name: Bow tie
items.why: Black-tie for a speechless day.
items.beat: Day 100; praise days.

items.name: Rosette medal
items.why: Out of verdicts (day 200): she awards herself, then you.
items.beat: Day 200.

items.name: Pink onesie
items.why: Photo 11. Dignity under pressure; never explained.
items.beat: Lines that mention it.

items.name: Red snowflake hoodie
items.why: Photo 20. The winter and New Year look.
items.beat: Day 10 poof; ro-02.

items.name: Mini backpack
items.needsRigMove: a back-straps layer on the body (straps over the shoulders in sit and stand)
items.why: First day of school energy; ready to travel.
items.beat: Walk-in entrances: she arrives packed.

items.name: Sleep mask on forehead
items.why: Woken up for you; mask still on.
items.beat: Wake-up entrance.

items.name: Graduation cap
items.why: Language milestone energy.
items.beat: Day 365 alternative.

items.name: Collar with bell
items.why: A tiny jingle as SFX on every head move: the body tells.
items.beat: Ear-tell days.
items.localeNotes: Text-free; no name tag (no names, ever).

items.name: Flashcards
items.why: Two cards: the viewer's own alphabet and another one. The exchange in one picture. She 'sat on her notes'.
items.beat: Day 3 (a habit); reg-19 'I sat on my notes'.
items.localeNotes: Front card shows the viewer's glyph (tr Ç, en A, es Ñ, fr É, de Ä, ru Ж, ar ع, pt-BR Ã); the back card a different script, rotating by day. No words.

items.name: Tiny dictionary
items.why: A fat little dictionary she clearly has not opened. 'I learned bag.'
items.beat: Day 21 with the reading glasses; ro-11.
items.localeNotes: Cover shows 'Aa' in a speech bubble only.

items.name: Desk globe
items.why: The world she claims to rule; it spins, she watches it like prey.
items.beat: reg-15 'On my planet…'; curious days. Tall enough to show over the caption.
items.localeNotes: Land masses are soft blobs with no borders: no map politics in any locale.

items.name: Speech-bubble sign
items.why: A protest-style sign held up for you, in three alphabets. Proud-fan energy she would deny.
items.beat: Day 1 (meeting); praise days. Above the caption the whole video.
items.localeNotes: Shows A / Ж / ع: Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, the app's eight locales' scripts. Glyphs, not words.

items.name: Passport with stamps
items.why: Her passport, stamped everywhere she has never been.
items.beat: Curious and diva days.
items.localeNotes: Stamps are shapes, no country names.

items.name: Alphabet blocks
items.why: She stacks them, then knocks the top one off.
items.beat: Knock-off move.
items.localeNotes: One glyph per locale, like the flashcards.

items.name: Postcard
items.why: A postcard from a partner's country, a picture side only.
items.beat: Soft days.

items.name: Pencil
items.why: The bible's own knock-off object.
items.beat: reg-12 'I knocked something off the counter in your honour.'

items.name: Notebook (sat on)
items.why: 'I sat on my notes.' Literally.
items.beat: reg-19 as a seat.

items.name: Trophy
items.why: Day 100, the act breaks completely: the trophy is bigger than her head and she cannot speak.
items.beat: Pops in at the number on day 100, glinting.
items.localeNotes: Plaque is blank: no numbers on screen besides the counter.

items.name: Cake with one candle
items.why: One candle, because cats can't count (bible §8.2). Lovable and quietly on-theme.
items.beat: Day 200 and the big round days.

items.name: Confetti cannon
items.why: Confetti starts at day 30 (bible §8.1); now it has a source, and it goes off a beat too early for her.
items.beat: Fires exactly at the number on day 30.

items.name: Gift box
items.why: Day 365: she gives you something. It is probably the box she wants to sit in.
items.beat: Day 365 next to the crown.

items.name: Balloon
items.why: Floats high where the caption can't hide it; she eyes it like the next thing to knock down.
items.beat: Day 50 with the crown.

items.name: Fridge edge (set piece)
items.why: The Fridge arc: misses on 7, 30, 50, makes it on 100.
items.beat: Ledge at the frame edge for the jump-fail.

items.name: Mirror frame
items.why: Her one rival lives in it.
items.beat: ro-01 'It copied me. Rude.'

items.name: Snow globe (seasonal)
items.why: Winter look with the hoodie.
items.beat: In-app or campaign renders only: the shared streak video is keyed by streak day and cannot know the date.
items.localeNotes: Hemisphere and holidays differ by locale; another reason to keep seasons out of the streak video.

items.name: Pumpkin (seasonal)
items.why: A hollow pumpkin is a seat.
items.beat: Campaign renders only (date-keyed).
items.localeNotes: Halloween is not universal across the eight locales.
